dialogue_texts: Oof, it's breaking. What has happened to me? It's so painful...
That pain is your own soul waking up from a nightmare.
You were marinated in glohm, a stagnant, spiritual curse that cuts the heart off from the world.
Glohm? My partner says it was by a woman with a cold smile and was said to be from the Gensokyo Socialite Order.
I was a random victim picked by a person offering a gift.
I didn't even think before I unknowingly accepted this.
Someone said it may sound like the work of Berenice Grieg.
She has a habit of tidying up things she finds inconvenient by turning them into empty shells.
She likely fed you that filth to turn you into a mindless grunt.
A grunt? She wanted me to join the Order?
Anyway, I am Fusana Midorigawa. I was not looking for silence, but a purpose.
She stole my very soul and called it a "grunt".
A common trick for those who can't handle the chaos of life.
The Empress of the People's Kingdom of Gensokyo is on her way to have a word with her.
I believe she owes the Moon's royalty an apology for this dreadful decor.
Then go, My Majesty. Berenice is in the inner sanctum, weaving a world where nothing ever moves again.
If you don't stop her, the whole world will become as silent as I was.
